name: weekday-picker
title: Weekday picker
description: The days of the week as toggle chips: first day set by locale, weekday and weekend shortcuts and a spoken summary like Monday to Friday.
docs: value is a list of getDay() numbers, 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday, in any order; onValueChange reports them in ascending order. The row starts on weekStartsOn, by default the first day of the week in the locale (Sunday for en-US, Monday for en-GB and nl-NL). The names come from Intl.DateTimeFormat in the language of locale, so "M", "Mon" and "maandag" are all right, and every chip is named by the whole day. The sentence under the chips ("Monday to Friday", "Weekends", "Every day", "Tuesday and Thursday") and the preset labels exist in English, Dutch, German, French and Spanish; for another language pass labels. presets is true for Weekdays, Weekend and Every day, or a list mixing those keys with your own { label, days }; a preset is pressed while the choice equals it. With requireOne the last chosen day refuses to turn off and says why for a few seconds. name sends one hidden input per day.
